correctness.rationale: For every nonnegative gap triple, every factor has zero, one or two ones. The two-one factors are unbordered precisely when an exterior gap used exceeds the inner gap, yielding the exact phase formula. Disjoint geometric series give the bivariate GF and its derivative. Uniform integer compositions converge to the uniform simplex, where a polygon inclusion--exclusion computes the explicit limiting CDF and mean 20/27. The extracted standalone program passes 2024 exhaustive direct word/factor checks, every bidegree through 48 of both rational series, and numerical limiting-law sanity checks. Finite tests do not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Longest unbordered factors are a natural object in string periodicity and compressed-pattern algorithms. The exact gap boundary sharply separates two length regimes for an infinite fixed-composition family, and the complete finite-length bivariate rational distribution plus explicit nondegenerate limiting CDF and mean supply information neither captured by a general-purpose algorithm nor a one-parameter toy count. The statistic and conditioning are intrinsic, not an arbitrary post hoc slice.
